regions.cleaned_text: Wm Fulsher a Convert (not practically so yet) 30 yrs. Old a car- penter living in Wyandotte Enrolled as against falling; was working on the Michigan Alcolie Building almost finished at the time was prying with a crow-bar which slipped. A fall was threa- tened of about 200 feet with nothing to grab. Without knowing how it came a fence appeared behind him and to his astonishment and everyone watching the work, he took hold of that fence and was entirely. His wife heard first about it from non-Catholic boarders in a neighboring hotel. She is ever since a zealous promoter.
